I bought the game a loooong way back, I have no idea how far it's progressed and I didn't get very far into it. Mostly due to lack of people to play with. If I were to start the game today, what should I expect out of it? Are there any cool raids? What sort of changes have happened since the original release? Thanks

Well it's still free to play, so you don't need a sub and the base game gets you most of the main storyline up through Transylvania . There are elite and nightmare mode 5 man dungeons at the end, and three raids right now I think. The endgame gearing is not too bad, a bit grindy but then what MMO isn't. You'd be able to do them all though. If you feel like spending a few buck you can get some of the expansions but they aren't necessary for the most part. They recently rebalanced the learning curve a bit so that you don't run up against huge difficulty spikes during the regular story line and the animations seem good at least to my eye.

All in all I think the game is in a decent place.

Where did you leave off playing at? I've got a toon that's just starting out and one of our guildies is still in the blue mountain area.

I didn't get too far into the game, I think I stopped at an area which was a school/college ground with people held up in there. Not sure what the story was about, I think it was a college for young people who have powers? Again, not entirely sure.

Are people still interested in old content? How much time am I expecting to put in before I reach the end game? I do love story content in MMO's and I think TSW has the best, i'm not rushing into it but i'd like to know.

Innsmouth Academy, that's in the second area of Solomon Island. lots of good quests around there. The older content holds up surprisingly well. The devs have managed to keep it relevant as they advanced the storyline. The recent rebalance I mentioned fixed a great deal of little issues with the older stuff. Seeing as how that's still right next to the starter zone it's usually fairly busy. You still have the blue mountain ahead of you on the island, then an interlude before heading to Egypt which is two areas then to Transylvania which is three. Id suggest that you do the story versions of the dungeons as you come to them as they drop level appropriate blue gear. As for endgame you can start it as soon as you can use ql10 gear across the board. So if you want to do that then do all the quests you can find and get AP/SP. You can pick up some timed AP boosts in the item store fairly cheap if you're in a big hurry but i'd suggest taking it easy to enjoy the storyline. The last time I took a character up to endgame I went pretty slow and only played on weekends and still got it there in about a month of playing which is about a week to ten days of actual play time. But I was by no means pushing it, several of us were leveling as a group so we took our time and hit everything.
